prompt.main_subject: An adult woman rests beneath a quilt in morning light and looks up sleepily toward an overhead camera.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle overhead shot; fingers stroke a pillow, the face emerges from the pillow, arms stretch toward the camera, and the quilt frames a comfortable morning pose.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Clear morning light with crisp bird sounds outside and a dreamlike, hazy bedroom mood.

technical_specs.motion: Slow sleepy head lift, pillow nuzzle, arm stretch, and relaxed movement under the quilt.
technical_specs.format: Video format is not specified in source.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Maintain a high-angle overhead shot. An adult woman under a quilt unconsciously strokes the pillow, then lifts her head with sleepy eyes and looks innocently toward the camera. She gently nuzzles the pillow, revealing her face, and makes an expression of not being fully awake and not wanting to get up. She stretches her arms toward the camera, fingers reaching into the morning light, while her body relaxes comfortably under the covers. In a hoarse, slightly morning-grumpy voice she softly says, "The light... is so bright... (yawn) I don't want to get up yet..." Let the trailing voice drift into crisp bird sounds outside the window.
